reason: A DSH host plugin for durable cross-session memory, conversation summaries, agent memory tools, and planned context injection, with browser panels and graph visualization.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供跨会话 Markdown 记忆库、会话总结、Agent 记忆工具和可配置的上下文注入，并配有记忆管理面板与图谱视图。
summaries.en: A DSH host plugin that provides a cross-session Markdown memory library, session summaries, agent memory tools, configurable context injection, and memory management visualizations.

capabilities: persists memory records as Markdown files
automatically injects selected memories and summaries into model context
provides agent tools to search, read, save, enable, pin, and schedule memories
summarizes selected conversation turns using an LLM
provides browser panels and a force-directed memory graph
exposes a local HTTP JSON API
